items.summary: Recommendation: Reject production changes, financial claims, and retries of failed queue work. Current telemetry is too low-volume and site-level revenue is unavailable; 31 repair items remain open and no improvements are proven. Preserve existing measurement gates and authorize one bounded, read-only public reachability check for blackmarketapparel.com to distinguish a transient compliance probe failure from an actual outage. Decision question: authorize this single evidence-only check?
